limits: Not optical photographs or LCD transport verification.
Snapshot internal causal RMS and relative offset are internal receiver observations, not calibrated UTC or physical PPS accuracy.
Role history, missing HOT and unknown delivery denominator are preserved as displayed.
GNSS HDOP is receiver geometry; VAR NONE is unknown election variance, not measured zero.
Private enrollment, exact hardware identities, enrolled firmware images and raw console/pixel logs are excluded.
